glosses: A circular symbol with white and black sections (☯), representing the fusion of the concepts of yin and yang.

examples.text: U.S.S. Millicent asked Mario if he'd ever seen a girl's yin-yang before.
examples.ref: 1996, David Foster Wallace, Infinite Jest […], Boston, Mass.; New York, N.Y.: Little, Brown and Company, →ISBN, page 124:

examples.text: "So I took off my apron and told her she could shove the job up her yin-yang."
examples.ref: 2009, Stanley William Rogal, What Passes for Love, page 76:

raw_glosses: (colloquial, somewhat vulgar) The vulva or vagina.

examples.text: He thought he could smuggle the drugs over the border by putting them in capsules and stuffing them up his yin-yang. Not a good idea!
"... I'd be on that phone call every single day. I'd be up that guy's yin-yang so far with a firecracker he wouldn't know what hit him," the Ontario premier said of Pfizer's executives.
examples.ref: 2021 January 19, CBC News, “Saskatchewan will run out of COVID-19 vaccine in the next few days, Moe says”, in Saskatchewan:

raw_glosses: (colloquial, somewhat vulgar) The anus or rectum.
